title: Change & Adoption Manager - AI
description:
Are you passionate about helping people embrace change and get real value from new technology?


This is an exciting opportunity to play a key role in how British Heart Foundation (BHF) adopts AI, helping our colleagues build the confidence, skills and understanding they need to make AI-enabled ways of working part of everyday life.


As our Change and Adoption Manager – AI, you’ll lead technology adoption for AI across BHF and will turn emerging AI capabilities into practical, sustainable changes in how colleagues work, supporting the organisation to realise value from its investment in AI.


About the role


Working within our AI Control Tower, you’ll develop and deliver our approach to AI technology adoption, partnering with organisational change and adoption colleagues to support the wider AI-enabled transformation.


You’ll assess readiness for AI tools and their impact on day-to-day work, identify barriers to adoption and develop targeted interventions that help colleagues confidently embrace new ways of working. This could include communications and engagement, learning, coaching and practical resources that strengthen AI literacy and capability.


You’ll also support the adoption of capabilities including Microsoft Copilot, platform-based AI, automation and future AI-powered solutions, adapting your approach as new technology emerges.


This role focuses on sustained use of AI technology and changes in everyday working practices, rather than IT service change-control or technical release management.


About you


You’ll bring significant experience of leading technology adoption, having successfully improved adoption, capability and sustained behaviour change in previous roles.


With previous experience of developing and delivering change and adoption strategies and interventions, including communications, engagement, learning and coaching, you’ll also understand how to assess change impacts, organisational readiness and barriers to adoption, turning insight into practical action.


You’ll also have:

  • Strong knowledge of organisational and behavioural change principles.
  • Experience of using evidence and insight to measure adoption and the effectiveness of change interventions.
  • Excellent stakeholder engagement skills, with the confidence to influence, coach and constructively challenge.
  • Strong communication and facilitation skills, making complex change clear and relevant for different audiences.
  • The ability to build trusted relationships across business and Technology teams.
  • Strong planning and organisational skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities.
  • ?A proactive and adaptable approach, with a strong focus on practical outcomes.

A recognised change management qualification such as Change Management Institute ACMF, Prosci ADKAR or APMG Change Management, or equivalent practical experience, is required.


If you’re excited by the opportunity to help colleagues confidently embrace AI and embed meaningful, sustainable change, we’d love to hear from you.


Working arrangements


This is a 12-month fixed-term contract.


This is a hybrid role, where your work will be split between your home and at least one day per week, on average, in our London Office. This may vary from time to time, so you will need to work in a flexible way to unlock your best work for our cause.


Belonging at BHF


By embracing diversity and fostering an inclusive environment, we strengthen our ability to achieve our mission of saving and improving lives, ensuring our work reflects and serves the needs of every community across the UK.


To hear from our people, check out Belonging at BHF.


Our people are at the heart of everything we do. By funding research across six decades, we’ve helped keep millions of hearts beating and millions of families together. We’re investing in ground-breaking research that will get us closer than ever to a world where everyone has a healthier heart for longer.


Interview process

?

Interviews for this role will follow the below process:

  • Initial 20-30 minute MS Teams call with the hiring manager, these will be held w/c 30th November
  • In person, at our London office, panel based interview,. which will incorporate a presentation, held Monday 7th December
  • Virtual stakeholder panel session, held on Tuesday 8th or Wednesday 9th December.

How to apply


It’s quick and easy to apply for a role at the BHF. Just click on the apply button below. All you’ll need is an up-to-date CV and a supporting statement, outlining your interest in the role and how you meet the role’s criteria.


Our recruitment processes are fair, accessible and inclusive. BHF use anonymous CV software as part of the application journey.


We support responsible use of AI to help shape your application. By applying for a role at BHF, you confirm that your application is authentic and reflects your own skills and experience, to ensure everyone is assessed fairly.


Should you need any adjustments to the recruitment process, at either application or interview, please contact us.
